# larkfield-api: staging environment
# Copy to .env and fill in the placeholders. Never commit the real .env.
# Note: the app does not load .env itself. Use `node --env-file=.env src/server.js`
# or export the variables in your shell.

# Port the Express server listens on (defaults to 3000 if unset)
PORT=3000

# Staging Postgres (AWS eu-west-2, reachable on the internal network/VPN only)
# Get the staging credentials from your team's secret store.
DATABASE_URL=postgres://<user>:<password>@pg-stg-3.larkfield.internal:5432/larkfield_stg
